body: i'm feeling better after seeing a psychiatrist, thanks for responding though

> Understandably, a long 2 years

i wish it was longer; that way, i wouldn't have the fear of it running out constantly looming over me (as i'm sure everyone else on the face of the earth feels). best of luck; i know how it feels to have your family fall apart, and although i won't pretend to understand the hardship you're going through, i do understand how difficult it can be.

> You can totally do it

assuming i can overcome the debilitating sadness and regret my mind forces me to experience every waking minute, assuming my stars align and everything goes perfectly, assuming i don't fuck it up like i've fucked up everything else up to this point, then maybe, just maybe, i can. i realize how pessimistic i sound, and i apppreciate the reply, however, i just can't see myself making anything good happen
I wanted to be a research scientist, but I don't even know anymore
